messages:
sara: Heads-up  manager submitted a mid-cycle comp bump for an IC transitioning to a tech lead role (~12%). Need clarity on docs + routing.
dave: Standard: manager completes comp-change intake + attaches promo evidence. Routing depends on run-rate delta. Link to intake: https://redwood-internal/forms/comp-change
lia: Quick checklist from People Ops perspective: 1) Evidence doc (bullets: new responsibilities, systems/people impacted, examples of ownership) 2) Manager endorsement 3) Managers manager approval 4) Finance cost code.
tony: Finance rules: include ECD, annualized delta, and GL code. If delta > $15k/yr, route to Sr Finance for approval. Also include employee HRIS ID to prevent manual corrections.
sara: Does the evidence doc need peer feedback or can it be manager-only? manager is asking.
lia: Peer feedback is helpful but not required. Strong examples of impact matter most. Use the promo-evidence-template (Drive) for quick coverage.
finance-bot: FYI: automated budget check will run once the form is submitted. If budget check fails, a ticket is created for Finance review.
sara: Is there a policy on retroactive pay? manager asked about backpay to the start date of expanded duties (3 weeks ago).
dave: Retro is allowed but exceptional. Finance prefers retro <= 60 days and requires justification + CFO signoff for backpay > 30 days. Also flag as "retro" in the form so payroll queues it properly.
lia: Timing: to land on next payroll you need full approvals and the comp-change submitted >= 7 business days before payroll close. Shorter windows may be possible but risk missing the run.
sara: What about combining with equity refresh? manager hopes to bundle to reduce approvals.
dave: Equity is separate (handled by comp-ops). Do not mix in the comp-change form; it'll complicate routing and auditing.
sara: Got it. Another edge: the person is promotion-eligible but currently in a temporary band exception. Any special handling?
lia: If current band is an exception, include the exception memo and previous approval thread. People Ops will validate band rules; if crossing band, additional signoffs needed (manager-chain + People Ops director).
tony: Also confirm if any retro budgets were used earlier this fiscal; Finance will want to know cumulative impact.
hr-bot: People Ops reminder: required attachments = evidence doc, cost center, HRIS employee ID. Optional = peer notes, 1 pager of role scope.
sara: Thanks all. I'll resubmit with evidence and tag PRIORITY for payroll consideration. Will DM the template link. :thumbsup:
dave: Ping if you need an expedited review and we'll coordinate with Finance.
lia: Saving this thread for the playbook. If anyone hits an odd edge case, reply here and we'll triage.
